"/"
  /conf → /conf  (edit the config and system prompt)
  /copy <target> → /copy …  (copy a target to the clipboard)
  /ctx → /ctx  (list sources contributing to model context)
  /edit <target> → /edit …  (open a target in your editor)
  /fork [<options>] → /fork …  (fork this session)
  /forward <port> → /forward …  (forward a sandbox port to the host)
  /grant <access> <path>... → /grant …  (grant temporary access to a path)
  /grants [all] → /grants …  (list effective access and forwarded ports)
  /help → /help  (list the commands and targets)
  /info → /info  (show every bar segment with its current value)
  /job <action> → /job …  (inspect, stop, or discard a background job, or prune finished ones)
  /jobs → /jobs  (list this session's background jobs)
  /new [<options>] → /new …  (start a new session)
  /open <target> → /open …  (open a target with its default application)
  /reply → /reply  (reply inline to the last answer in your editor)
  /revoke <target>... → /revoke …  (revoke temporary path grants or forwarded ports)
  /sub <action> → /sub …  (read a subagent's conversation)
  /subs → /subs  (list this session's subagents)
"/c"
  /conf → /conf  (edit the config and system prompt)
  /copy <target> → /copy …  (copy a target to the clipboard)
  /ctx → /ctx  (list sources contributing to model context)
"/e"
  /edit <target> → /edit …  (open a target in your editor)
"/f"
  /fork [<options>] → /fork …  (fork this session)
  /forward <port> → /forward …  (forward a sandbox port to the host)
"/forward "
"/forward 8"
"/expose "
"/g"
  /grant <access> <path>... → /grant …  (grant temporary access to a path)
  /grants [all] → /grants …  (list effective access and forwarded ports)
"/grant "
  r → /grant r
  rw → /grant rw
"/grants "
  all → /grants all
"/job "
  discard → /job discard
  output → /job output
  prune → /job prune
  status → /job status
  stop → /job stop
"/job st"
  status → /job status
  stop → /job stop
"/job stop "
  build → /job stop build
  docs → /job stop docs
"/job output d"
  docs → /job output docs
"/job prune "
"/job stop docs "
"/job discard "
  build → /job discard build
  docs → /job discard docs
"/job bogus "
"/jobs "
"/!"
"/!ls"
"/n"
  /new [<options>] → /new …  (start a new session)
"/new "
  -m → /new -m …  (pick which model to use)
  -c → /new -c …  (configure access rights)
  -t → /new -t …  (replace current toolbox)
  --yolo → /new --yolo  (run outside the sandbox)
  -f → /new -f …  (fork a previous session)
"/new son"
"/new --f"
  --from → /new --from …  (fork a previous session)
"/new --from "
  able-dolphin → /new --from able-dolphin
  agile-turtle → /new --from agile-turtle
  tame-impala → /new --from tame-impala
  wise-otter → /new --from wise-otter
"/new -f"
  -f → /new -f …  (fork a previous session)
"/new -f "
  able-dolphin → /new -f able-dolphin
  agile-turtle → /new -f agile-turtle
  tame-impala → /new -f tame-impala
  wise-otter → /new -f wise-otter
"/new -m son"
  anthropic/claude-sonnet-5@medium → /new -m anthropic/claude-sonnet-5@medium
  anthropic/claude-sonnet-5@high → /new -m anthropic/claude-sonnet-5@high
"/new -m gpt@h"
  codex/gpt-5.6-sol@high → /new -m codex/gpt-5.6-sol@high
"/new -m sol@high+f"
  codex/gpt-5.6-sol@high+fast → /new -m codex/gpt-5.6-sol@high+fast
"/new -m nothing-like-it"
"/new -m sonnet "
  -c → /new -m sonnet -c …  (configure access rights)
  -t → /new -m sonnet -t …  (replace current toolbox)
  --yolo → /new -m sonnet --yolo  (run outside the sandbox)
  -f → /new -m sonnet -f …  (fork a previous session)
"/new -m o"
  anthropic/claude-sonnet-5@medium → /new -m anthropic/claude-sonnet-5@medium
  anthropic/claude-sonnet-5@high → /new -m anthropic/claude-sonnet-5@high
  anthropic/claude-opus-5@high → /new -m anthropic/claude-opus-5@high
  anthropic/claude-opus-5@max → /new -m anthropic/claude-opus-5@max
  codex/gpt-5.6-sol@high → /new -m codex/gpt-5.6-sol@high
"/new -m opencode-"
  opencode-go/minimax-m3 → /new -m opencode-go/minimax-m3
"/new -m codex@h"
  codex/gpt-5.6-sol@high → /new -m codex/gpt-5.6-sol@high
"/new -m minimax"
  opencode-go/minimax-m3 → /new -m opencode-go/minimax-m3
"/new -m minimax@"
"/new -m opus@m"
  anthropic/claude-opus-5@max → /new -m anthropic/claude-opus-5@max
"/new -m opus+f"
"/new -"
  -m → /new -m …  (pick which model to use)
  -c → /new -c …  (configure access rights)
  -t → /new -t …  (replace current toolbox)
  --yolo → /new --yolo  (run outside the sandbox)
  -f → /new -f …  (fork a previous session)
"/new --"
  --model → /new --model …  (pick which model to use)
  --caps → /new --caps …  (configure access rights)
  --tool → /new --tool …  (replace current toolbox)
  --yolo → /new --yolo  (run outside the sandbox)
  --from → /new --from …  (fork a previous session)
"/new --m"
  --model → /new --model …  (pick which model to use)
"/new --model "
  anthropic/claude-sonnet-5@medium → /new --model anthropic/claude-sonnet-5@medium
  anthropic/claude-sonnet-5@high → /new --model anthropic/claude-sonnet-5@high
  anthropic/claude-opus-5@high → /new --model anthropic/claude-opus-5@high
  anthropic/claude-opus-5@max → /new --model anthropic/claude-opus-5@max
  codex/gpt-5.6-sol@high → /new --model codex/gpt-5.6-sol@high
  opencode-go/minimax-m3 → /new --model opencode-go/minimax-m3
"/new -m "
  anthropic/claude-sonnet-5@medium → /new -m anthropic/claude-sonnet-5@medium
  anthropic/claude-sonnet-5@high → /new -m anthropic/claude-sonnet-5@high

"/new -c rx -c "
"/new -t "
  bash → /new -t bash
  grep → /new -t grep
  read → /new -t read
"/new -t read -t "
  bash → /new -t read -t bash
  grep → /new -t read -t grep
"/new -t read -"
  -m → /new -t read -m …  (pick which model to use)
  -c → /new -t read -c …  (configure access rights)
  -t → /new -t read -t …  (replace current toolbox)
  --yolo → /new -t read --yolo  (run outside the sandbox)
  -f → /new -t read -f …  (fork a previous session)
"/new -t read -t grep -t bash "
  -m → /new -t read -t grep -t bash -m …  (pick which model to use)
  -c → /new -t read -t grep -t bash -c …  (configure access rights)
  --yolo → /new -t read -t grep -t bash --yolo  (run outside the sandbox)
  -f → /new -t read -t grep -t bash -f …  (fork a previous session)
"/new -t read -t grep -t bash -"
  -m → /new -t read -t grep -t bash -m …  (pick which model to use)
  -c → /new -t read -t grep -t bash -c …  (configure access rights)
  --yolo → /new -t read -t grep -t bash --yolo  (run outside the sandbox)

"/new -t read -t grep -t bash -t "
"/new -x "
"/fork "
  -m → /fork -m …  (pick which model to use)
  -c → /fork -c …  (configure access rights)
  -t → /fork -t …  (replace current toolbox)
  --yolo → /fork --yolo  (run outside the sandbox)
  -f → /fork -f …  (fork a previous session)
"/fork opus"
"/fork --from "
  able-dolphin → /fork --from able-dolphin
  agile-turtle → /fork --from agile-turtle
  tame-impala → /fork --from tame-impala
  wise-otter → /fork --from wise-otter
"/fork -f "
  able-dolphin → /fork -f able-dolphin
  agile-turtle → /fork -f agile-turtle
  tame-impala → /fork -f tame-impala
  wise-otter → /fork -f wise-otter
"/fork -m opus"
  anthropic/claude-opus-5@high → /fork -m anthropic/claude-opus-5@high
  anthropic/claude-opus-5@max → /fork -m anthropic/claude-opus-5@max
"/fork -m sol@high+"
  codex/gpt-5.6-sol@high+fast → /fork -m codex/gpt-5.6-sol@high+fast
"/fork -m sonnet -c rxw --yolo "
  -t → /fork -m sonnet -c rxw --yolo -t …  (replace current toolbox)
  -f → /fork -m sonnet -c rxw --yolo -f …  (fork a previous session)
"/fork --yolo -"
  -m → /fork --yolo -m …  (pick which model to use)
  -c → /fork --yolo -c …  (configure access rights)
  -t → /fork --yolo -t …  (replace current toolbox)
  -f → /fork --yolo -f …  (fork a previous session)
